## Claims
- [source-backed] The reported computational verification range is \(r\le4\) and \(n-r\le5\). [source-6, lines 46-54]
- [source-backed] For \(\mathfrak S_v=s_{i^j}\), the parameters are \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\), and each proposed family has \(N=\binom{a+b}{a}\) generators. [source-6, lines 18-42]
- [proved] Put \(q=n-r\). For nonempty rectangular data \(i,j\ge1\), \(N>1\) holds exactly when
  \[
  1\le i\le q-1,\qquad 1\le j\le r-1.
  \]
  Indeed, \(b\ge1\), while \(a\ge1\) exactly under these two strict inequalities; then \(\binom{a+b}{a}\ge2\). If \(i=q\) or \(j=r\), then \(a=0\) and \(N=1\).
- [proved] Interpreting “immediately beyond” as enlarging the tested rectangle to \(r\le5,\ q\le6\), the admissible new parameter instances with \(N>1\) are:
  \[
  \begin{array}{c|c|c|c}
  r&q=n-r& (i,j)&\#\\ \hline
  5&2,3,4,5,6&
  1\le i\le q-1,\ 1\le j\le4&4(q-1)\\
  2,3,4&6&
  1\le i\le5,\ 1\le j\le r-1&5(r-1)
  \end{array}
  \]
  Equivalently, these are \((r,n)=(5,7),(5,8),(5,9),(5,10),(5,11)\) and \((2,8),(3,9),(4,10)\), with the indicated \((i,j)\). The overlap \((r,q)=(5,6)\) occurs only in the first row. There are \(60+30=90\) such \((r,q,i,j)\)-instances.
- [conjectural] The two Schur generating families are minimal for each of these 90 instances; this is not established by their enumeration.

## Strategy
Use \(q=n-r\) and enumerate the one-step enlarged rectangle \(r\le5,\ q\le6\), removing the old range \(r\le4,\ q\le5\). Impose \(N>1\) via \(a,b\ge1\).

## Gaps
The supplied evidence does not identify the corresponding \((s,t)\) for each \((r,q,i,j)\), nor does it prove minimality or compute \(J_v/\Lambda_+J_v\) for any newly listed instance.

## Next
Translate the listed \((r,q,i,j)\) cases into the paper’s \(v_{r,s,t,n}\) parametrization and compute the integral indecomposables presentation for selected boundary cases.
